question: to the Commission Geadis Geadi (ECR) Subject:

Last Saturday, 1 August 2026, in my capacity as an MEP, I attended the Municipality of Famagusta’s annual anti-occupation event, in order to denounce the grim anniversary of the Turkish invasion. The event was also attended by the President of the Republic of Cyprus, as well as MPs and other officials. During the event, Ottoman marches could be heard from the occupied areas, as the occupying authorities chose to turn the loudspeakers’ volume to maximum as an act of provocation. However, this was not the end of the provocations. There were repeated violations of the buffer zone by unmanned aerial vehicles (drones)1, which took off from the occupied areas and flew over the site of the anti-occupation event in the Municipality of Famagusta and over the heads of officials. In view of the above, can the Commission say: 1.
How does it intend to react to this latest Turkish provocation?
Does it intend to impose sanctions on Türkiye, as it does in similar cases against the Russian Federation?
